title: data-prep-spec template variables
description: Values for templates/data-prep-spec.md.j2 and templates/data-prep-spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from data-prep-spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

assistant_column.title: Assistant column
assistant_column.description: Messages assistant. From section 'Schema map (rule r1-jsonl-schema)'.

base_model.title: Base model
base_model.description: Target base model. From section 'Data-Prep Spec'.

class_ratio_after.title: Class ratio after
class_ratio_after.description: Class ratio before / after balancing. From section 'Split (rule r3-train-val-split, r4-balanced-classes)'.

class_ratio_before.title: Class ratio before
class_ratio_before.description: Class ratio before / after balancing. From section 'Split (rule r3-train-val-split, r4-balanced-classes)'.

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.description: Planned epochs. From section 'Token budget (rule r2-token-budget)'.

estimated_usd.title: Estimated usd
estimated_usd.description: Estimated cost (USD). From section 'Token budget (rule r2-token-budget)'.

over_cap_count.title: Over cap count
over_cap_count.description: Examples rejected over cap. From section 'Token budget (rule r2-token-budget)'.

pii_id_count.title: Pii id count
pii_id_count.description: Customer / ticket IDs. From section 'PII scrub (rule r6-no-pii)'.

pii_phone_count.title: Pii phone count
pii_phone_count.description: Phone (E.164 / national). From section 'PII scrub (rule r6-no-pii)'.

raw_row_count.title: Raw row count
raw_row_count.description: The raw row count used under 'Source'.

rejected_column.title: Rejected column
rejected_column.description: Non preferred output (dpo only). From section 'Schema map (rule r1-jsonl-schema)'.

total_tokens.title: Total tokens
total_tokens.description: Total tokens (one epoch). From section 'Token budget (rule r2-token-budget)'.

train_count.title: Train count
train_count.description: The train count used under 'Split (rule r3-train-val-split, r4-balanced-classes)'.

training_file_id.title: Training file id
training_file_id.description: OpenAI training file ID. From section 'Output'.

user_column.title: User column
user_column.description: Messages user. From section 'Schema map (rule r1-jsonl-schema)'.

val_count.title: Val count
val_count.description: Validation count. From section 'Split (rule r3-train-val-split, r4-balanced-classes)'.

validation_file_id.title: Validation file id
validation_file_id.description: OpenAI validation file ID. From section 'Output'.
